## About
Green Jeans is owned by husband-and-wife team Kevin Sadlier and Xander Wessells. Kevin's love of gardening took root as a chef in Key West, where a rooftop herb and vegetable garden fed the kitchen. Xander's began with a summer job tending perennial gardens on the coast of Maine.
They met working at the same nursery after coming to Marin and have been running the shop in the same location ever since, often with their kids in tow. When they're not at the shop, you can find them foraging for culinary mushrooms.
We cater to anyone from homeowners and landscape professionals to designers and backyard farmers. After all, a healthy planet begins in your own backyard. Customers rate us 4.8 from 38 Google reviews.

## Services
- Flowers & Plants: Perennials, trees, fruit trees, shrubs, vines, annuals, vegetable starts, edibles, natives, succulents, ground covers, cover crops, seeds, bulbs, house plants, air plants and orchids.
- Fertilizers & organic pest control: Only organic fertilizers and the least toxic pest control, so you can garden responsibly in your own backyard.
- Organic soils: We are dedicated to offering only organic soils.
- Curios & Pottery: Pottery and curios for the house and garden.
- Adirondack chairs: Adirondack chairs built from reclaimed redwood.
- Fire pits: Gas and/or wood burning fire pits made in the USA and composed of 100% recycled metal.
- Botanical illustrations and insect sculptures: Botanical illustrations by local artists and larger-than-life metal and glass mosaic insect sculptures.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: Yes. We're open 7 days a week. Give us a call if you want to check hours before you come in.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're at 690 Redwood Highway in Mill Valley, right off the highway.

Q: Is everything you sell organic?
A: We offer only organic fertilizers and soils and the least toxic pest control.

Q: Do you work with landscape professionals?
A: Yes. We cater to anyone from homeowners and landscape professionals to designers and backyard farmers.

Q: Do you have a newsletter?
A: We do. Send us your email address and we'll send you our newsletter with organic gardening tips, upcoming events and store specials.
